slot: Contract templates (MSA, SOW, NDA, DPA, BAA, AI addendum)

pick.name: Common Paper standard agreements
pick.what: Free Cloud Service Agreement, PSA, mutual NDA, DPA, BAA, AI Addendum, SLA, order form/SOW
pick.why: Widest free set incl. BAA and AI Addendum; CC BY 4.0 so commercial use is fine; cover-page format buyers recognise

alts.name: Bonterms
alts.what: Standard Cloud Terms, PSA, NDA, DPA, BAA
alts.why: Committee-drafted alternative some enterprise buyers already know

alts.name: Local-law templates drafted by counsel
alts.what: Lawyer adapts governing law, arbitration and formalities
alts.why: Needed when your counterparty insists on local law (e.g. India stamp duty, EU consumer rules)

candidates.name: Bonterms
candidates.verdict: Equal quality; use if the buyer proposes it

decision: Use Common Paper for SaaS (CSA + order form), services (PSA + SOW), NDA, DPA, BAA and AI Addendum. Set governing law deliberately and have a lawyer review the cover-page defaults once. Standard US-style terms may ignore local formalities: verify with a professional.

verify.note: Shallow: CC BY 4.0 standards, commercial OK.
